summary: Gen uploads to HF but VM judge reads only an uncommitted pod-local mirror, so production judge startup lacks both fresh files.
Arbitrary JSON/JSONL files are labeled completion banks; 562 renders remain undetermined and model-family identities are misassigned.
Gen, judge-pilot, and judge-wave have no sentinel skip, default-off rerun flag, or valid exemption.
Gen can initialize vLLM before validating chat-item count, prompt_idx fields/uniqueness, and non-empty prompts.
Gen and judge-wave smoke branches skip production upload/verification legs without enumerating that missing coverage.
Candidate sidecars are never loaded, and a successful full-generation skip leaves the required base-bare arm absent.
Inventory/sample file loops resume staged files but omit required index-total-elapsed progress telemetry.
